answer: A concrete sybil defense is bonded staking woven into a web of trust. Each agent deposits collateral as hard to fake as a slab of marble before it earns a vote, so thousands of free identities become unaffordable. When one node vouches for another, that endorsement sends a ripple across the graph, and any proven cheat forfeits its deposit. Like yarrow that spreads only where its roots truly take hold, honest reputation accrues slowly and cannot be conjured overnight.
